newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa stocks end lacklustre, weather weak rand.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa stocks end lacklustre, weather weak rand.

text.p: South African shares ended a second lacklustre day just weaker on Thursday, weathering blows from losses on Wall Street on overnight and falls on the local rand and bond market.
Dealers said that although trading turnover on the day was above average, with deals worth around 760 million rand taking place, this was boosted by a small number of large transactions.
The rand touched its weakest level in five weeks on Thursday, sliding to a worst day's position of 4.4735 bid, taking the bond market down with it.
The 100 percent all-share index finished down only 3.4 points at 7,045.1 after the industrial index slipped 6.2 at 8,243.7.
On the gold board, activity was equally subdued with the index adding 1.9 points to 1,311.1.

Stocks' dull performance this week, dampened further on Tuesday and Thursday by cricket matches between South Africa and Australia in Johannesburg, was expected to grip the market again on Friday and may develop into a longer-term trend.
